text:
Maya - Sales: Quick heads-up 1 HelixPay wants a 6-week pilot. We need POC scope, success metrics, pricing anchor, and any enterprise blockers. Kickoff Wed 2pm.

Evan (Solutions): Proposed focused scope: A) Daily transaction digest for reconciliation UI, B) Auto-categorized dispute recommendations, C) High-confidence AML signal tagging. Prioritize A then B.

Rachit Eng: From infra: need per-endpoint latency SLOs and expected peak concurrency. For digests aim median <140ms, p95 <380ms on 512 tokens. Disputes okay with higher tails. Also need sample prompt CSV to run batch/cost sims.

Sam (Security): We'll need the security questionnaire completed, a sanitized dataflow diagram, retention TTLs, and confirmation of KMS usage in staging. Also: will tokens ever leave customer VPC during Dedicated trial?

Maya - Sales: Client requested SSO demo + short written answers. They estimate ~220k tokens/week and 1.8k embeddings/week. Any quick price anchor for hosted?

Nora (CSE): Hosted anchor ~ $2.2k/week with current model suggestion and caching. If they want Dedicated windows for heavy tuning, add burst pricing. Hybrid (hosted + scheduled Dedicated runs) is viable.

Evan (Solutions): Draft timeline: Week 0: security/legal check, infra prep. Week 1: integration + sample prompts. Weeks 2-3: tuning + evals. Week 4: UAT. Week 5: wrap and handover.

Rachit Eng: For sizing I need peak RPS (they mentioned ~15?), avg prompt+completion tokens, and cache hit rate. If we get a 200-row prompt CSV we can run estimates. Also confirm whether they allow a small sanitized log sample.

Sam (Security): Conditional kickoff approval if they sign NDA addendum and provide sanitized logs + dataflow. Also need subprocessors list.

Evan (Solutions): Proposed acceptance criteria to include in SOW:

- Digest: median latency <=140ms, p95 <=380ms, accuracy >= 0.90 on reconciliation set (n=200)
- Dispute recs: recall >=0.87, false positive <=9% on labeled set (n=150)
- AML tagging: precision >=0.8 with manual-review fallback, flagged flow latency <=800ms
- Integration: SDK + 2 endpoints in staging, SSO demo recorded, smoke tests pass
- Security: questionnaire complete, sanitized dataflow, KMS verified in staging

Nora (CSE): I'll prepare 3 prompt templates + eval harness. Recommend 150-200 eval samples per flow. Pass threshold: 70% overall on rubric.

Maya - Sales: Anything blocking Wed kickoff?

Rachit Eng: Blockers: need prompt CSV, concurrency numbers, and permission for sanitized logs. If those arrive by EOD we'll be on schedule.

Sam (Security): And NDA addendum + subprocessors list. Without those we can't sign off.

Evan (Solutions): I'll draft the SOW success criteria and short pricing appendix with host vs hybrid options.

pilot-bot: Created staging project "hpilot-1923456789" and added Maya, Evan, Rachit, Nora, Sam.

Maya - Sales: I'll push the client for the CSV and legal items and update this thread. Thanks everyone.
